title: Contact Center & Conversational Transformation
breadcrumb: Solutions > Workforce & Experience > Contact Center & Conversational Transformation
meta_description: Resolution-first voice and chat — measured on outcomes, not deflection.

blocks.x: Resolution-first voice and chat — measured on outcomes, not deflection.
The problem this solution exists for
IVR trees deflect; context dies at transfer; compliance transcript duties unmet; cost per contact climbs while CSAT falls.

We rebuild conversational operations: grounded voice/chat agents resolving top intents, emotion-aware escalation with context handoff, agent-assist summarization, and resolution analytics steering the operating model.

items: real-time context, summaries and next steps

blocks.x: The solution runs on KYC Management System and EEMS Platform: Hundreds of agents as one governed, measurable workforce.  Enterprise decisions in milliseconds — with the evidence to defend every one.
How it runs in an engagement

items: baseline metrics for this problem locked with owners; current-state decision/data flow mapped in two weeks.
gated pilot on bounded scope with the falsifiable criterion agreed by finance before the first build sprint.
staged rollout on the platform stack with SLOs, replay evidence and operator enablement.
challenger models and policies quarterly; conformance monitoring; annual value audit against baseline.
reference architecture adapted to your estate, with the integration contracts itemized.
the composed capability live on bounded scope, with evidence generation built in.
runbooks, SLO catalog and the named-pod accountability chain for production.
baseline pack, measurement method and the quarterly review template your finance team signs.

blocks.x: Data readiness matters more than data volume: the diagnostic phase surfaces gaps, and the design phase prices them — no program pretends the estate is cleaner than it is.

items: Real-time fraud decisioning on instant rails — 38% lower fraud losses at a higher approval rate
KYC refresh backlog cleared — 70% faster cycles with agentic file assembly

blocks.x: Deployed across Banking & Financial Services, Insurance & Risk, Telecom, Media & Entertainment, Healthcare & Life Sciences, Retail & Consumer Goods. Each industry play adjusts the regulatory frame, the integration surface and the KPI set — the pattern stays, the physics changes.
